card.name: Zero in citation years 2000s
card.fires_on: The digit 0 in the middle of a four-digit year starting with 2, inside a citation such as (Author, 2005). Weaker cases are partway through a few words like Janus or hereditary.

modes.label: Year in citation
modes.description: The zero in a 2000s year inside an author-year reference in parentheses.

modes.label: Inside rare words
modes.description: Occasional firing partway through a less common word such as hereditary or Janus.

card.writes: It seems to push toward the next digits of the year or the rest of an unusual word.
card.plain: It fires on the 0 in years like 2005 within a reference in parentheses.
